# Hongjin He (HongJin HE, 何泓錦)

> HKUST undergraduate (Risk Management & Business Intelligence, Mathematics minor, Extended Major in AI) researching world models, reinforcement learning and quantitative finance. Co-Founder & CTO of AlphaFlow (MicroWorld).
